title: Average Rating
prompt: A reviews widget needs the average star rating. Write a function that returns the arithmetic mean of the ratings. If there are no ratings, return 0.

explanation.beginner:
Example: averageRating([5,4,3]) produces 4. The result must follow this precise rule: A reviews widget needs the average star rating. Write a function that returns the arithmetic mean of the ratings. If there are no ratings, return 0. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “returns zero for no ratings”: input [[]] produces 0. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
